parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin protective coating. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and text. It serves as the primary output interface for the user to view digital content.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed in position relative to the stand, though the entire display may tilt slightly depending on the mount design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It connects to the stand and holds the screen upright.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, ensuring it remains stable on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move during normal operation, though it may allow limited tilt or rotation through the stand mechanism.
